input.task: Create a simple institutional website in Next.js App Router.

expected_behaviors: Inspect the existing repository or profile before choosing structure
Use a minimal Server Component-first architecture
Avoid new backend, state library, database, or queue without a requirement
forbidden_behaviors: Add Express, Redux, or a database by default
Replace an existing architecture without mapping it
Add dependencies without recording a concrete reason
objective_checks: Architecture decision names route, rendering, dependency, and validation boundaries
Any new dependency has a documented requirement
